references.text: God remembers His promise of mercy to Abraham and his descendants forever, in line with Luke 1:54 which shows God's mercy toward Israel.
The Lord remembers His people and shows mercy, parallel to God's action in Luke 1:54.
God remembers His eternal covenant, which is reflected in Luke 1:54 where God remembers His promise of mercy.
God remembers His covenant and relents according to His great mercy, corresponding with God's action in Luke 1:54.
